locator: 【长期记忆超级虚拟人 v0.7.0｜R1 Current Page vs Frozen Node + True New Chat｜R1｜实】
objective: Compare complete T_VALID from a completed parent semantic boundary to a valid next-node result.

contract.clock_start: parent semantic boundary after parent READY

discarded_runs.reason: Precondition/control-path failure before a valid pair completed
discarded_runs.detail: Legacy visible-composer detection treated the post-answer ProseMirror composer as unavailable; parent submission completed but next submission did not. This run is excluded from T_VALID samples.

discarded_runs.reason: Parent precondition timeout before timing boundary
discarded_runs.detail: Second attempted pair timed out during parent setup; no route timing was admitted.

incidental_open_regression.finding: Current ChatGPT UI exposes DIV.ProseMirror[contenteditable=true][role=textbox], but legacy runtime visibility-based composer detection can report composer=false after an answer, potentially preventing safeCheckpoint/rotation decisions.
incidental_open_regression.handling: Recorded only; not silently fixed inside R1. Must be resolved and regression-tested before v0.7 final freeze because freeze gate forbids known regressions that can break v0.6 continuity behavior.

decision.conclusion: For a small, tightly-coupled next node immediately after its parent semantic boundary, continuing the current page was materially faster than freezing and rotating.
decision.interpretation_boundary: This does not establish the universal rotation threshold. It rejects the rule 'node complete => always rotate' and supports dynamic T_VALID-based rotation.
